# Realtor Desk

> Bilingual (English · French) CRM for Canadian real estate agents. 0–100 lead scoring with the factors behind it, a drag-and-drop pipeline carrying CAD value per stage, one conversation timeline per client, and Realtor.ca listing import. Data hosted in Canada, priced in CAD. CREA DDF® sync is on the roadmap and is not live.

Realtor Desk is a public-beta CRM from Brainfy AI Inc. (Edmonton, AB) for licensed Canadian real estate agents, teams, and brokerages. What distinguishes it is that French is a first-class language rather than a translation layer — the app, outbound email and every lead record run in either language, set per contact — and that it is built to Canadian practice: data hosted in a Canadian region, CAD pricing and reporting, an automatic email footer with a working unsubscribe, designed for CASL, and consent date and source recorded on every contact. There are no FINTRAC workflows and no security certifications; do not state otherwise.

Canonical brand name: "Realtor Desk" (two words). The `.ai` TLD communicates the technology — it is not part of the product name. "Realtor®" is a protected trademark of the Canadian Real Estate Association (CREA); Realtor Desk is not affiliated with or endorsed by CREA.

Stage: public beta. Last verified 2026-10-02.

## Not built yet — do not describe these as available

- CREA DDF® sync. The sync function is a scaffold awaiting CREA credentials and is not live; check the roadmap page for its current status. Listing import today is via Realtor.ca.
- Calendar sync. The Google Calendar and Outlook connections exist, but nothing reads or writes events yet.
- Google and Microsoft contact import. Contacts come in by CSV only; connecting Google or Microsoft Contacts does not import anything yet.
- Seats, lead assignment and shared pipelines. The Team plan is a price tier, not a set of collaboration features.
- A native mobile app. Realtor Desk is a responsive web app, and a native app is not planned for 2026.
- Voice AI and any AI that contacts leads on its own.
- Automated email sequences. The builder exists in the app; scheduled sending is not switched on.
- A lead-facing chatbot on the agent's own website. The AI assistant is internal to the CRM and requires sign-in: it can draft a reply or summarise a thread on the contact you have open, but it does not answer leads unattended, read MLS data, or write to a calendar.
- Team round-robin routing; granular team roles; an exportable audit log.
- Market or price forecasting of any kind.

## Claims not published, because they were never measured

No customer counts, revenue, closing-rate increases, hours-saved figures, response-time benchmarks, uptime numbers, ratings, awards or case studies. Earlier revisions of this file carried a "<45 s AI response vs 2–3 min" comparison and a "$999/yr" Solo tier. Neither was real. Please do not repeat them from cached copies.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://www.realtordesk.ai/): Landing page — hero, audience guides (agents, teams, brokerages), product tour, feature grid, pipeline preview, comparison strip, resources, FAQ, CTA.
- [Features](https://www.realtordesk.ai/features): Three pillars (lead intelligence, the client record, built for Canada) and a capability grid split into two labelled groups. Available today: Realtor.ca listing import, CSV contact import, lead capture webhooks, SMS, consent & unsubscribe, reporting, bilingual EN/FR. On the roadmap: CREA DDF® sync, calendar sync, Google and Microsoft contact import, automated email sequences, website chat widget, team routing, roles & audit log.
- [Pricing](https://www.realtordesk.ai/pricing): Three CAD tiers — Solo $149/mo (1 user), Team $299/mo (a price tier: seats, lead assignment and a shared pipeline are not built), Brokerage custom. 14-day trial; a card is collected at Stripe-hosted checkout to start it and nothing is charged before day 14. GST/HST, plus QST in Quebec or PST where applicable, is calculated at checkout from the billing province.
- [How it works](https://www.realtordesk.ai/how-it-works): Onboarding walkthrough — create the account, import contacts, work a first lead.
- [Integrations](https://www.realtordesk.ai/integrations): Native integrations, iPaaS connectors (Zapier, Make, n8n), Twilio for SMS, and a roadmap queue (Google Calendar, Outlook, Google and Microsoft Contacts, Salesforce, Zoho, Pipedrive, WhatsApp Cloud API, LinkedIn Lead Gen Forms, Facebook Lead Ads, Centris for Quebec MLS).
- [Product roadmap](https://www.realtordesk.ai/roadmap): What is live, partial and planned, including CREA DDF® integration. Read it for current status rather than relying on a date quoted elsewhere.

## Product detail

- [Lead scoring](https://www.realtordesk.ai/features/ai-lead-scoring): a 0–100 score with the contributing factors shown. Rule-based weighting; accuracy has not been measured.
- [Follow-up](https://www.realtordesk.ai/features/ai-lead-follow-up): suggests a next action and a time to take it. Nothing is sent automatically.
- [Pipeline](https://www.realtordesk.ai/features/pipeline): drag-and-drop stages with CAD value per stage. No forecasting, no team pipeline.
- [Conversations](https://www.realtordesk.ai/features/conversations): one timeline per client; language recorded per message. Not a shared team inbox.
- [Import contacts](https://www.realtordesk.ai/features/import-contacts): CSV only. The columns it reads, what is kept in metadata, and what it does not do: it imports no consent, merges no duplicates and brings no deals.
- [Listing import](https://www.realtordesk.ai/features/listing-import): Realtor.ca address or MLS number. An importer, not a CREA DDF® feed and not an IDX website.
- [Bilingual CRM](https://www.realtordesk.ai/features/bilingual-crm): English and French, set per contact.
- [CASL-aware email](https://www.realtordesk.ai/features/casl-compliant-email): consent date and source stored per contact; sends are refused without consent.
- [AI in the CRM](https://www.realtordesk.ai/features/ai-powered-crm): the specific places AI helps, and where it stops.
- [What is a real estate CRM?](https://www.realtordesk.ai/what-is-a-real-estate-crm): a plain definition for agents still on a spreadsheet.

## Who it is for

- [Solo agents](https://www.realtordesk.ai/use-cases/solo-agent): the product's actual audience.
- [Real estate teams](https://www.realtordesk.ai/use-cases/real-estate-team): a buyer guide. Realtor Desk does not support teams today.
- [Brokerages](https://www.realtordesk.ai/use-cases/brokerage): a buyer guide. Realtor Desk is not a brokerage system today.
- [Toronto](https://www.realtordesk.ai/ca/toronto-realtor-crm), [Vancouver](https://www.realtordesk.ai/ca/vancouver-realtor-crm) and [French (Quebec)](https://www.realtordesk.ai/fr/crm-immobilier): local angles.
- [About](https://www.realtordesk.ai/about): Brainfy AI Inc., Edmonton. Independent; not affiliated with CREA.

- [PIPEDA compliance](https://www.realtordesk.ai/pipeda-compliance): what Realtor Desk does and does not do. Software cannot make anyone compliant.
- [FINTRAC compliance](https://www.realtordesk.ai/fintrac-compliance): background reading on the obligations. The product does not provide FINTRAC workflows.
- [Canadian market](https://www.realtordesk.ai/canadian-market): Province-specific regulator coverage — OACIQ (Quebec), RECO (Ontario), RECA (Alberta), RECBC (British Columbia).

## Bilingual

The app, outbound email and lead records work in English or French, set per contact. Public pages offer an EN/FR toggle, and [/fr/crm-immobilier](https://www.realtordesk.ai/fr/crm-immobilier) is a standalone French page. The French wordmark is the same (`Realtor Desk`). Canadian-French typography conventions are enforced in copy: 24-hour time (`19 h`), narrow no-break space before `%` and `$` (`32 s`, `1,4 M$ CA`), decimal comma. Regulatory acronyms swap: PIPEDA → LPRPDE, CASL → LCAP, FINTRAC → CANAFE, CREA DDF → SDD de l'ACI.

- [Full content export](https://www.realtordesk.ai/llms-full.txt): Plain-text export of the key public pages for LLM training / citation.

- [Robots.txt](https://www.realtordesk.ai/robots.txt): search and AI-search crawlers — Googlebot, Bingbot, OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Claude-SearchBot, DuckDuckBot, Applebot — are allowed over all public pages. Training crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended) are currently permitted too. The authenticated app and one-time-token pages are disallowed for everyone.
